event.title: Paramount Delays Warner Bros. Buyout Amid Legal Challenge
event.canonical_title: Paramount Delays Warner Bros. Buyout Amid Legal Challenge
event.summary: Paramount has agreed to postpone the closing of its $81 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery until at least June 2027. This decision comes as a federal judge considers a legal challenge from 12 states seeking to block the merger. Paramount will incur penalties for each day the deal remains unclosed after a September 30 deadline.

timeline.title: Paramount Delays Warner Bros. Buyout Amid Legal Challenge
timeline.summary: Paramount has announced a delay in finalizing its $81 billion acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. The merger will be postponed until a court ruling on a lawsuit filed by twelve states or until June 1, 2027. The states argue that the merger would create a significant media monopoly detrimental to the entertainment industry.
key_facts: Paramount's buyout of Warner Bros. is valued at $81 billion.
The merger is delayed until a court ruling or June 1, 2027.
Twelve states are challenging the merger, citing concerns over media monopolization.
